{"id":1919860065,"question_id":4217,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 1 week","timestamp":1771143175,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"163 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1919860065/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"First Element with Unique Frequency","memory":"289.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int firstUniqueFreq(vector<int>& nums) {\n        unordered_map<int, int>freq;\n        for(int x : nums) freq[x]++;\n\n        unordered_map<int, int>freqCount;\n        for(auto p : freq) freqCount[p.second]++;\n        \n\n        for(int x : nums){\n            if (freqCount[freq[x]] == 1) {\n                return x;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return -1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"first-element-with-unique-frequency","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1711}
